headline: Joint presentation on affordable housing by Massachusetts Housing Partnership, plus Round 1 and Round 2 project updates.
summary: Shelly Goehring, Senior Program Manager for Community Assistance at the Massachusetts Housing Partnership, will present with the Affordable Housing Trust Fund board. Susan Daly will also give updates on Round 1 and Round 2 projects.
